typography.instructions: Import these fonts via Google Fonts in index.css. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Apply `tracking-tight` to headings. Do not center-align body text or dense content.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 (border-slate-200). Sharp or subtly rounded (max rounded-md / 6px). Avoid overly soft, pill-shaped UI elements for this admin context, except for specific buttons.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal ambient shadow for interactive elements. Default to flat surfaces with 1px borders. Use shadow-sm or shadow-md only for floating elements like dropdowns, modals, and the mobile navigation drawer.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for this data-heavy admin panel. Use solid backgrounds.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: High Density Grid (Mode B). Dense, functional spacing. Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboard metric cards, but maintain generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6) inside containers.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Base grid-cols-1, md:grid-cols-2, lg:grid-cols-4. Summary metrics take col-span-1. Charts take col-span-2 or col-span-3.
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Desktop: Fixed Sidebar (w-64) + Main Content Area. Mobile: Sidebar hidden, triggered via Hamburger menu into a Navigation Drawer. Header must contain active period, Masehi & Hijri dates, and user profile.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense information, tables, and lists. Center align ONLY for empty states or small decorative components.

components_rules.cards: Go mostly cardless or use sharp 1px borders with solid white background. Avoid deep drop shadows. Use `p-6` for internal padding.
components_rules.buttons: Slightly rounded (rounded-md), consistent interaction states. Primary CTA uses emerald-900, secondary uses slate-100.
components_rules.tables: Dense rows. Header text should be subtle uppercase (text-xs tracking-wider text-slate-500). Hover states on rows (hover:bg-slate-50). Provide pagination.
components_rules.forms: Use Shadcn forms. Inputs should have subtle focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500). Left-align labels.
components_rules.status_indicators:
CRITICAL: Status must NEVER rely on color alone. Always pair color with text and an icon. e.g.,
Gagal
components_rules.evaluation_stars: Teacher evaluation uses a 1-5 Star UI. Use the star icon from lucide-react. Unfilled: text-slate-300, Filled: text-amber-500. Add interactive hover states for filling the stars during evaluation.
components_rules.drawer: Use Vaul or standard Shadcn Sheet/Drawer for Mobile Sidebar and drill-down details.

motion.hover: Subtle opacity and slight transform (-translate-y-[1px]) for buttons and metric cards.
motion.transitions: DO NOT use `transition-all`. Specify transitions, e.g., `transition-colors duration-200` or `transition-transform duration-200`.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in (framer-motion) for dashboard metric cards.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, menus, table actions) MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over any colored background has a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds where content sits behind.

login_background.description: Minimalist white architecture representing clean, modern Islamic design. Use this as a split-screen background for the Login page with a black/30 overlay.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Language must be strictly Bahasa Indonesia across the UI.
Ensure both Masehi (Gregorian) and Hijriah (Islamic) dates are clearly visible in the top header.
Include empty, loading, and error states for all data tables and charts.
Use drill-down detail drawers (side panels) or modals instead of forcing users to a new page for quick details.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.

dashboard_specifics.header: Render App Name, Active Period, Tanggal Masehi & Hijriah, and User Profile. Must be sticky on top.
dashboard_specifics.summary_cards: Render Sekolah, Pengajar, Armada, Kehadiran, Monitoring, Dokumentasi as 'X/Y' or simple metrics.
dashboard_specifics.sections: Include 'Rencana Besok', 'Realisasi Hari Ini', 'Plan vs Realisasi' chart, and 'Perlu Perhatian' (Needs Attention) panel.

workflows.roster_upload: Show preview with valid/invalid row report clearly color-coded (success/danger) with icons.
workflows.teacher_evaluation: Implement the 1-5 star interactive UI component using Lucide-react stars.

instructions_to_main_agent.responsiveness: Ensure Sidebar cleanly transforms to a navigation drawer on mobile viewports.
